_README: Pincode -> region classification used for the ATS rural-address bonus. Keys are 6-digit Indian pincodes (as strings); values are 'rural' or 'urban'. Pincodes not present here are treated as 'unknown' and earn NO bonus. Derived from the India Post All-India Pincode Directory: a pincode is 'rural' when Branch Offices outnumber Sub/Head Offices (BO > SO + HO), else 'urban'. Regenerate with: python scripts/build_rural_pincodes.py
